name: 98664 · Vancouver, WA
findings: ZIP 98664 (Vancouver) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98664 (Vancouver) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
